name: x-negative-extension-form-z-minus-128
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.19 (ASN.1 unaligned PER): x -1 is outside the root: bit 1, length 1, ff; y -4 is 1 above lb: one octet 01; z -128 is one octet 80 (fewest octets of two's complement); presence 00. 141 bits, padded with 3 zero bits to 18 octets. Derived without an engine by a standalone X.691 reference program (Python standard library) and checked against two independent ASN.1 UPER codecs on the ASN.1 module in the pack header: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper; asn1tools checks y (INTEGER (-5..MAX)) only as a length and octets, because it encodes a semi-constrained integer as an unconstrained one, which X.691 does not.
